cases.title: 城市绿地与热暴露：面向不同空间尺度、观测窗口与不确定性表达的可重复合成研究

sections.title: 摘要 / Abstract

This study uses a fully synthetic urban temperature scenario to examine sampling, temporal windows, and uncertainty. No record describes a real person or city.

For reproducibility, each analytical choice is linked to a declared unit of observation and a fixed synthetic input. We distinguish a descriptive association from a causal claim, and we preserve the denominator alongside every aggregate. A discrepancy between windows is retained as evidence about sensitivity rather than removed as an inconvenient result.

paragraphs: 本研究用虚构观测网络测试重复记录、缺失值与异常标记的质量控制规则。该条目是预设的既往接收后制作情景，仅供检查排版与元数据，不代表系统执行过接收决定。
This manuscript studies synthetic environmental network quality using local invented inputs. All people, organizations, numbers, and source records are synthetic fixtures, not empirical evidence.

sections.title: 1 引言 / Introduction
paragraphs: 环境网络数据质量需要区分研究问题、输入边界与可核查的结果。本情景将这些内容分段保存，便于编辑回到原句核对研究范围。
The research question concerns synthetic environmental network quality. We distinguish the declared scope from any claim about real populations, institutions, or operational performance.

sections.title: 2 材料与方法 / Methods
paragraphs: 合成网络含六个虚构节点，逐小时生成演示记录并插入已知缺陷。质量规则保留原值，以标记说明重复键、缺失值和越界值。
Every input is generated locally for this manuscript scenario. The attached dictionary records the observation unit, field labels, and generation assumptions; no external collection is performed.

sections.title: 3 统计分析 / Analysis
paragraphs: 检查按已知注入缺陷计算检出率与误报率。不同规则分别统计，不将重叠警报重复当作新增缺陷。

The analysis preserves the original denominator and reports limitations alongside the summary. A computed metric is an illustration of the stated rules rather than a validated result from a real dataset.

sections.title: 4 结果 / Results
paragraphs: 重复键、缺失标记和越界规则的合成检出率分别为100%、96%和92%；结果取决于预设缺陷，不说明真实网络可靠性。

Figure 1 presents the fixed values for synthetic environmental network quality. The values should be read with their synthetic units and declared denominator, without extrapolation beyond the scenario.

sections.title: 5 讨论 / Discussion
paragraphs: 规则检测需要保留可追溯的输入与标记。当前演示没有真实设备、地点或运维记录，不能作为真实观测网络的验收证据。

A complete editorial record should connect the question, method, displayed result, and qualification. Private workspace annotations do not change the submitted text or constitute a published decision.

sections.title: 6 局限性 / Limitations
paragraphs: 本研究仅含本地合成材料，没有真实总体抽样框或独立验证。虚构作者、机构与来源不应被当作真实联系人、履历或文献证据。
This fixture cannot establish scientific validity, ethics approval, or operational safety. Replacing its content with real material would require a separate authorized process and fresh evidence.
